note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: doctrine/sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter and highlighter; tokenizes, no syntax tree.

leads.name: jdorn/sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter; no syntax tree.

leads.name: iamcal/sql-parser
leads.reason: MySQL CREATE TABLE schema parser; cannot parse the SELECT or INSERT controls (scope mismatch).

leads.name: phpmyadmin/sql-parser
leads.reason: new Parser($sql) builds statement objects (SelectStatement, InsertStatement) with components; MySQL dialect.

leads.name: greenlion/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: PHPSQLParser->parse($sql) returns a nested array parse tree (SELECT, FROM, WHERE ...).

leads.name: nilportugues/sql-query-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter that returns text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: staabm/sql-parser-util
leads.reason: Utility extracted from doctrine/dbal 2.13 SQLParserUtils that rewrites named and list parameters into positional ones; it returns SQL text and parameters, no syntax tree.

leads.name: soundintheory/php-sql-parser
leads.family: PHP-SQL-Parser lineage (2013 fork; shared with greenlion)
leads.reason: (new PHPSQL\Parser())->parse($sql) returns the clause-keyed array tree of the PHP-SQL-Parser lineage. 2013 PSR-0 fork of the Google Code project whose continuation is greenlion; no file identical to greenlion v5.0.0 after php -w, 54.3% of normalized statements shared. Verified with both controls; runs on PHP 8.5 with compile-time warnings.

leads.name: jasny/persist-sql-query
leads.reason: Query builder; its QuerySplitter cuts SQL into clause strings with regular expressions and returns text parts, not a tree with functions or literals.

leads.name: sqlftw/sqlftw
leads.reason: Not open source: composer.json at v0.1.17 (codeberg.org/paranoiq/sqlftw, commit 75ad341c) declares license ["proprietary"], and the repository root checked on 2026-11-17 has no LICENSE file (README.md, build, composer.json, doc, rector.php, sources, tests). The protocol requires an open-source release.

leads.name: sad_spirit/pg_builder
leads.reason: Query builder backed by a full PostgreSQL parser: createFromString($sql) returns a typed Select/Insert AST walked with the library BlankWalker. One statement per call (a trailing ";" is rejected), so the adapter splits at the library Lexer's ";" tokens. Verified with both controls.

leads.name: getdkan/sql-parser
leads.reason: Abandoned state-machine validator for DKAN's bracketed SQL-like query strings ([SELECT ...][WHERE ...]); validate() returns a boolean and there is no statement tree. Requires PHP < 8.2.

leads.name: manticoresoftware/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical fork of the selected greenlion/php-sql-parser: 5,030 of 5,157 normalized statements (97.5%) also occur in greenlion v5.0.0 and 145 of 177 files are identical after php -w; it lacks greenlion's window-function processors and adds Manticore-specific Add/Alter/Source processors. A spot check gives the greenlion tree for both controls. Not promoted to avoid counting one parser twice.

leads.name: marcocesarato/sqlparser
leads.reason: LightSQLParser exposes only getMethod, getFields, getTable and getAllQueries (regular-expression extraction); no join, function or literal structure for the summary.

leads.name: flow-php/postgresql
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: sql_parse()/Parser::parse() calls the pg_query extension's pg_query_parse_protobuf() and decodes the bytes with google/protobuf into the package's protoc-generated AST classes; ParsedQuery::traverse() walks that typed tree with NodeVisitor hooks. A wrapper over the selected pg-query-ext (libpg_query family), counted under the wrapper rule because its own PHP layer differs between the controls: Xdebug package lines 383 on the select control, 163 parse-time package lines differ; the native libpg_query AFL++ tuples are those of the extension's protobuf entry. Verified with both controls.

leads.name: rexshijaku/sql-to-laravel-builder
leads.reason: Converter that emits Laravel query-builder PHP code: 1.0.6 requires greenlion/php-sql-parser ^4.4 and turns its clause-array tree into builder method calls (text output, no own SQL parser). Not a separate parser path. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: nextras/multi-query-parser
leads.reason: Splits an SQL file into statement strings (multi-query file loader for migrations); no syntax tree. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: intersvyaz/yii2-sqlparser
leads.reason: Preprocessor for yii\db\Command SQL templates: expands special /*name ... */ and --*name comments and array parameters, returns SQL text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: jasny/dbquery-mysql
leads.reason: Abandoned on Packagist in favour of jasny/persist-sql-query; query builder with the same clause splitter design.

leads.name: calebdw/pg-schema-parser
leads.reason: Parses the schema of plain-text pg_dump output (DDL) on top of sad_spirit/pg_builder ^3.3; schema-only scope, and its SQL parsing is the already selected pg_builder. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: flow-php/pg-query-ext
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: PHP C extension (ext/pg_query.c) linking libpg_query 18.0.0 statically; the documented pg_query_parse($sql) returns libpg_query's JSON parse tree. Built from the pinned 0.48.0 archive with phpize against a source-built PHP 8.5.12; both controls match the oracle, LLVM covers ext/pg_query.c and libpg_query, and a native AFL++ overlay (ext/pg_query.c plus gram.c, scan.c, parser.c) gives stable, control-dependent tuples. Shared libpg_query family with the C libpg_query path. The split archive has no LICENSE; MIT is pinned from the flow-php/flow monorepo LICENSE at the same tag.

leads.name: tsukasa/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Code-style reformat of greenlion 4.x: 4,549 of 4,922 normalized statements (92.4%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, and the sampled differences are cosmetic (else if to elseif, closing tags, array syntax).

leads.name: udan11/sql-parser
leads.reason: Predecessor name of the selected phpmyadmin/sql-parser: Packagist marks it abandoned in favour of phpmyadmin/sql-parser and its repository is github.com/phpmyadmin/sql-parser (rename precedent: zend-json, trust-dns-proto).

leads.name: processfast/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical greenlion fork (2019): 4,764 of 4,825 normalized statements (98.7%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, 132 of 170 files identical after php -w.

leads.name: liquipedia/sqllint
leads.reason: Lint wrapper around phpmyadmin/sql-parser that reports errors; no own tree and no summary beyond the selected phpMyAdmin parser.

leads.name: crodas/sql-parser
leads.reason: (new SQLParser)->parse($sql) returns SQL\Select/SQL\Insert objects built by a PHP LEMON-generated parser; public getters expose tables, joins, columns, where, group, order, fields and values. Verified with both controls; 2016 code runs on PHP 8.5 with deprecations.

leads.name: michabbb/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: 2014 snapshot of greenlion 4.0.0 (self-described fork); 4,204 of 4,985 normalized statements (84.3%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, the remainder being older code of the same project.

leads.name: fmizzell/sql-parser
leads.reason: Same package description and repository (github.com/GetDKAN/sql-parser) as getdkan/sql-parser; validator for DKAN query strings, no statement tree.

leads.name: maghead/sqlite-parser
leads.reason: SQLite table schema parser (CREATE TABLE column and constraint definitions); schema-only, cannot parse the SELECT or INSERT controls (scope mismatch, like iamcal/sql-parser). Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: aitradeinc/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical greenlion copy: 4,826 of 4,852 normalized statements (99.5%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0.

leads.name: offsite-solutions/eisodos-sqlparser
leads.reason: Eisodos framework template renderer for <%SQL%...%SQL%> blocks (returns rendered text); not an SQL syntax parser.

leads.name: rstoetter/csmartsqlstatement-php
leads.reason: Manages SELECT statements as clause strings (GetWhereClause, GetOrderByClause, AddTable, SetLimits); returns and rewrites text clauses, no tree with joins, functions or literals. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: codexsoft/sql-parser
leads.reason: Statement splitter: parseString strips comment lines and explodes the text into statement strings; no syntax tree.

leads.name: subapp/sql
leads.reason: README documents an AST parser, but 1.2.2 requires symfony/yaml 4.2.0-BETA2, which Composer 2.11 refuses to install because of five Packagist security advisories (PKSA-nktx-f1n1-b4yd and others). The advisory block was not overridden, so the controls were not run. Re-checked 2026-11-18: 1.2.2 is still the latest release with the same symfony/yaml constraint; the advisory block was not overridden.

leads.name: bleksak/sqlite-toolkit
leads.reason: Round-3 search hit ("sqlite parser", 2026-11-18). (new Parser())->parse($sql) runs the package lexer and a token-at-a-time state machine for the SQLite 3.54.0 grammar and returns typed Ast\Select and Ast\Insert nodes (MIT LICENSE in the archive). Verified with both controls; Xdebug covers 1073 package lines and the parser-line AFL++ bridge differs by 983 tuples. Independent of inilim/sqlite-parser (phplrt grammar). Very low adoption (14 lifetime downloads).

leads.name: lbreme/lexepa-sql
leads.reason: Lexer/parser for a single SQL INSERT statement only (package description); cannot parse the SELECT control. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: ozh/sqltableextractor
leads.reason: Extracts table names from SQL queries; no statement tree, joins, functions or literals. Round-3 search hit (2026-11-18).

leads.name: xp-forge/sql-parser
leads.reason: Primary control fails in v0.4.0 (README: not yet complete): Parser->parse(...)->tree() throws text\sql\parse\Expecting "Expecting ; or (eof), have AS on line 2" at the table alias; the INSERT control parses.

leads.name: cadfael/mysql-antlr4-parser
leads.reason: No tagged release on Packagist (dev-main only), so no release can be pinned; 2 lifetime downloads.

leads.name: inilim/sqlite-parser
leads.reason: Spot check: Parser::parse returns a Script whose SelectStatement carries columns, from, joins, where, groupBy and orderBy for the primary control. Not promoted this round: the only release (2026-11-10, 1 lifetime download) has neither LICENSE nor README in its archive (composer.json declares MIT; the README exists only on main after the tag). Re-checked 2026-11-18: 0.1.20261110 (commit 807a841c) is still the only release; its codeload archive (SHA-256 6de5b61be341eee4f6baa60aa0c46f6574889a940898d49c6c238cbd55c4f30b) holds only composer.json and src/, and the repository main branch has no LICENSE file (README.md, composer.json, grammar, src, tests, ...), so the MIT declaration has no licence text; Packagist total still 1. Left unresolved, not promoted.

leads.name: k-kinzal/sql-parser
leads.reason: Zero Packagist downloads and no tagged release (dev-main only).

leads.name: vimeo/php-mysql-engine
leads.family: vimeo/php-mysql-engine hand-written MySQL parser (port of Slack hack-sql-fake)
leads.reason: Round-4 search hit ("mysql engine", 2026-11-18). In-memory MySQL simulation for tests whose README says it parses SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE with a validating query parser. The public final class Vimeo\MysqlEngine\Parser\SQLParser::parse($sql) (docblock-typed; not described in the README) returns SelectQuery/InsertQuery objects with FromClause tables, expression trees, groupBy and orderBy; it is called directly, without FakePdo, so nothing is executed. Both valid controls equal the oracle (the adapter cuts at the package SQLLexer's ';' lexemes because parse() rejects the terminator after INSERT or FROM). Engine-with-public-parser precedent: DuckDB in the C++ cell.

leads.name: cweiske/php-sqllint
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql validator"). Command-line syntax checker (AGPL-3.0) whose v0.2.3 composer.json requires phpmyadmin/sql-parser ^4.1.1; it reports the phpMyAdmin parser's errors and has no own tree, like liquipedia/sqllint.

leads.name: jimbojsb/pseudo
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("pdo mock"). PDO mocking library: Pseudo\Pdo::mock() registers SQL strings with result arrays and query() looks the text up (README 0.5); no SQL parser or tree.

leads.name: slack/hack-sql-fake
leads.family: vimeo/php-mysql-engine hand-written MySQL parser (port of Slack hack-sql-fake)
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql fake"). Hack-language (HHVM) testing library, not PHP; it is the origin named by the selected vimeo/php-mysql-engine README.

leads.name: vdauchy/sql-analyzer
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql analyzer"). Laravel query analyzer (0.4.1, requires ext-pdo and illuminate/database): src/analyzers/MySql.php and SQLite.php inspect EXPLAIN rows returned by the database; it has no SQL parser.

leads.name: pierresh/phpstan-pdo-mysql
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql validator"). PHPStan rules for PDO/MySQL code; 2.1.6 requires sqlftw/sqlftw ^0.1 for SQL syntax, which is excluded as proprietary in this cell; no own parser.

leads.name: zent/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). Self-described PHP-SQL-Parser copy (v4.1.3, 2018): 7,047 of 7,111 normalized statements (99.1%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0 and 137 of 177 files are identical after php -w (round-4 check, same method as the earlier greenlion forks).

leads.name: k-kinzal/sql-faker
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql grammar"). Grammar-based SQL generator (FakerPHP provider); it emits SQL text and does not parse it.

leads.name: chh/sirel
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql syntax tree"). SQL builder that builds its own AST from method calls and dumps SQL; no tagged release on Packagist and no SQL text input.

leads.name: janfish/phpmyadmin-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). Copy of phpmyadmin/sql-parser 5.4.2 under another name: 5,101 of 5,104 normalized statements (99.9%) occur in phpmyadmin/sql-parser 5.4.2 and 85 of 86 files are identical after php -w.

leads.name: dmitry-php/sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag lexer, q sql). Same description as phpmyadmin/sql-parser; no tagged release on Packagist (targeted lookup 2026-11-18), so no release can be pinned.

leads.name: tiny/sql
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql parse"). Described as an SQL parsing library, but Packagist lists no tagged release (targeted lookup 2026-11-18), so no release can be pinned.

leads.name: jtfnetoo/sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). Self-described fork of phpmyadmin/sql-parser (v4.1.6, 2017): 4,125 of 4,127 normalized statements (100.0%) occur in phpmyadmin/sql-parser v4.1.6 and 73 of 74 files are identical after php -w.

leads.name: dottwatson/php-mysql-engine
leads.family: vimeo/php-mysql-engine hand-written MySQL parser (port of Slack hack-sql-fake)
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("mysql engine"). Fork of the selected vimeo/php-mysql-engine with the same description (1.1, 2024): 5,903 of 6,740 normalized statements (87.6%) occur in vimeo 0.7.15 and 132 of 148 files are identical after php -w; the additions are data-source adapters (dottwatson/simple-data, justinrainbow/json-schema), not a separate parser. Not promoted to avoid counting one parser twice.

leads.name: erkineren/sql-manipulator

leads.name: dottwatson/fpdo
leads.family: vimeo/php-mysql-engine hand-written MySQL parser (port of Slack hack-sql-fake)
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). PDO wrapper whose 1.1 requires dottwatson/php-mysql-engine (a vimeo fork); no own parser.

leads.name: bleksak/mago-pdo-extension
leads.reason: Round-4 hit ("sql validator"). Mago static-analysis extension whose 0.0.6 requires phpmyadmin/sql-parser ^6.0 and bleksak/sqlite-toolkit ^1.0, both already selected; no own parser.

leads.name: rob-lester-jr04/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). Self-described PHP-SQL-Parser copy (v4.4.0, 2021): 7,111 of 7,137 normalized statements (99.6%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0 and 151 of 177 files are identical after php -w.

leads.name: zqx/sql-translation
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag parser, q sql). Translates custom bracketed formula expressions (for example date_diff([a],[b])) into MySQL or PostgreSQL expression text (README v1.2); not a statement parser.

leads.name: jozefhornik/php-mysql-engine
leads.family: vimeo/php-mysql-engine hand-written MySQL parser (port of Slack hack-sql-fake)

leads.name: fuwasegu/php-sql-snapshot
leads.reason: Round-4 hit (tag ast, q sql). PHPUnit extension that compares SQL through greenlion/php-sql-parser ^4.0 trees; no own parser.

leads.name: wordpress/mysql-on-sqlite
leads.family: WordPress MySQL-on-SQLite grammar-driven parser (MySQL Workbench grammar)
leads.reason: Round-4 lead from the "wordpress mysql parser" and "sqlite database integration" queries (both returned no Packagist package). WordPress/sqlite-database-integration (v3.1.3, 2026-11-03) contains a grammar-driven MySQL lexer and parser (packages/mysql-on-sqlite/src/mysql/class-wp-mysql-parser.php, grammar from MySQL Workbench MySQLParser.g4) whose composer.json names wordpress/mysql-on-sqlite, but neither that name nor wordpress/sqlite-database-integration is published on Packagist (HTTP 404, 2026-11-18). No primary metric, so not verified or ranked.

leads.name: kwasii/laravel-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-5 GitHub repository search (language PHP; sql parser, sql ast, mysql parser, sqlite parser, postgresql parser, sql lexer; 2026-11-18) mapped to Packagist; also the 33rd hit of the round-1 'sql parser' query, where its description ("Fast SQL Parser for PHP Laravel") was not followed up. README-documented parse API (Sql::parse(), and Dialect::get(...)->parseOne() without Laravel) returning sqlglot-style expression trees. Dialect::get(null)->parse() on both valid controls gives the oracle summary from Select/Insert, Table, Join, Func and Literal nodes; 1155 package lines covered in 63 files; parser-line AFL++ bridge identical over three repeats, 1168/828 tuples, 766 tuples differ. MIT, only release v0.1.0 (2026-10-10). Requires illuminate/* for its Laravel integration only. Port of Python sqlglot (shared design lineage across ecosystems); independent of the other PHP code bases.
